# Parse the note content into song titles and artists
note_content = note['content']
lines = [line.strip() for line in note_content.split('\n') if line.strip() and not line.startswith('#')]
songs = []
for line in lines:
    # Format: "Title by Artist" or "Title by Artist1, Artist2"
    if ' by ' in line:
        title_part, artist_part = line.split(' by ', 1)
        title = title_part.strip()
        artists = [a.strip() for a in artist_part.split(',')]
        songs.append((title, artists))
    else:
        # If no "by", treat whole line as title
        songs.append((line.strip(), []))
print(songs)
